scope.taper: Cosine weight from one to zero between 1.8 and 2.0 km to avoid an artificial crop-edge step
scope.interpretation: Four fixed published clone-minus-nominal perturbations, full inside 1.8 km and tapered to zero by 2 km; outer local/regional terrain is held nominal. Frequencies are conditional sample counts, not probabilities.
scope.numericalInterpretation: Numerical variants are a separate family; they are not added to the clone sample count.

observerCorrection.method: Translate the nominal apparent topocentric vector along the local radial axis, using its actual target range; validate against direct SPICE at start/middle/end for each variant, target and height.

fineStudy.description: Separate direct one-minute Shackleton study, not an automatic refinement of the current app inputs.

constructedThresholdProbe.description: Hypothetical limit chosen between sampled clone extremes; zero required Earth overlap isolates the darkness constraint. Not a real mission requirement.

assumptions.intervalConvention: half-open bins; last bin clipped at mission end
assumptions.sun: at least 50% disc visible; fixed radius 0.2666 deg
assumptions.feasibility: unknown: uncertainty tests are conditional near-field samples; regional uncertainty and full terrain completeness remain untested

candidateSource.scope: Explicit interior sample points, not whole-region coverage or certified landing candidates. Spatial variation is not calibrated terrain uncertainty. No cloned terrain outcomes are transferred from legacy research points.

spatialSource.scope: Published illumination study regions, not certified landing zones. Only the existing research-point markers have cached mission calculations. Display terrain is downsampled and is not the horizon calculation mesh.

sources.projection: South polar stereographic, MOON_ME/DE421; units and projection checked against native DEM
South polar stereographic, MOON_ME/DE421; units and projection checked against native DEM
South polar stereographic, MOON_ME/DE421; units and projection checked against native DEM

imagerySource.scope: Historical imagery context only; no scientific visibility inputs are changed. Masks and point-specific crop support are explicit.

imagery.acquisitionNote: Partial image coverage: undownloaded source strips are transparent. Missing pixels have not been filled or synthesized.

pointContext.message: The selected coordinate maps to a valid source pixel.

imagery.alignment: Product documentation estimates 5–20 m absolute positional accuracy. Relative registration to the current Site11 DEM has not been measured. No blind correction applied.
imagery.scope: Historical source-projected context crop. No image-to-DEM registration measurement or exact visual overlay is claimed. Source illumination is separate from mission replay.

spatialView.scope: Display state; separately calculated interior results are in regionStudy. Outlines are not continuously calculated.

ranking.method: Requirements first, then greater combined availability; ties within one observation bin. Rank spans use best/worst tested outcomes independently by site; they are conservative possibilities, not probabilities or matched global clone worlds.

activity.scope: Shared nominal + four conditional near-field clone + four numerical cases; regional uncertainty is not tested
